newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Troops of Operation Jaya Sikuru, or "Sure of Victory" capture Nedunkeni in northeast, security sources say.
Six hundred schools in the provinces to be elevated to a higher grade to ease demand for popular Colombo schools, says President Chandrika Kumaratunga.
Over 350 security forces personnel injured in Operation Jaya Sikuru being treated at Anuradhapura hospital in northcentral Sri Lanka, defence sources say.
Troops take Nedunkeni, a Tamil Tiger rebel stronghold northeast of Vavuniya, on Sunday, security sources say.
Troops take Nedunkeni amid stiff rebel resistance.
Army deserter succumbs to wounds when he shot himself after killing a soldier in daring escape attempt.
Nedunkeni liberated by troops of Operation Jaya Sikuru, say defence sources.
President Kumaratunga tells teachers to work with dedication and fulfil their obligations towards younger generation.
